blurb: `Result` takes two type arguments, the success type and the error type: `Result[T, E]`. `Map` takes two as well, `Map[K, V]`, and a type applied to an empty `[]` needs at least one. A `Result[Int]` leaves out the error a caller has to handle, so it is refused rather than guessed. Give every argument.
